# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Root of the popover: scopes the trigger and the content for the Stimulus
  # controller. open: renders it open on load (shadcn's defaultOpen).
  #
  # options: is the older API and still works as a fallback: placement: when
  # PopoverContent gets no side:/align:, and trigger: "hover" when
  # PopoverTrigger gets no open_on_hover:. Without either, the popover opens
  # on click, Enter or Space, as shadcn's does.
  class Popover < Base
    def initialize(open: false, options: {}, **attrs)
      @open = open
      @options = options
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "popover",
          controller: "ruby-ui--popover",
          ruby_ui__popover_open_value: @open.to_s,
          ruby_ui__popover_options_value: @options.to_json
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The popup. A native popover="manual" (top layer, so no ancestor with
  # overflow: hidden clips it) with role="dialog", placed next to the trigger
  # by Floating UI. side:/align: pick the placement (side also takes the
  # logical :inline_start / :inline_end), side_offset:/align_offset: the gap,
  # with the defaults of shadcn's PopoverContent. Without side:/align:,
  # Popover's options placement: applies, then bottom/center.
  class PopoverContent < Base
    SIDES = %i[top right bottom left inline_start inline_end].freeze
    ALIGNS = %i[start center end].freeze

    def initialize(side: nil, side_offset: 4, align: nil, align_offset: 0, **attrs)
      @side = SIDES.include?(side&.to_sym) ? side.to_s.tr("_", "-") : nil
      @align = ALIGNS.include?(align&.to_sym) ? align.to_s : nil
      @side_offset = side_offset
      @align_offset = align_offset
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        popover: "manual",
        role: "dialog",
        tabindex: "-1",
        data: {
          slot: "popover-content",
          ruby_ui__popover_target: "content",
          # Kept in sync with data-open/data-closed for CSS that targets data-[state=...].
          state: "closed",
          closed: "",
          preferred_side: @side,
          preferred_align: @align,
          side_offset: @side_offset,
          align_offset: @align_offset
        },
        class: [
          # Resets the UA popover box; display:flex must not beat the UA's hidden closed popover.
          "fixed inset-auto m-0 border-0 [&:not(:popover-open)]:hidden",
          "z-50 w-72 origin-(--transform-origin) outline-hidden",
          "bg-popover text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-md p-4 text-sm shadow-md duration-100",
          "data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95",
          "data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-closed:fill-mode-forwards",
          "data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2",
          "data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2",
          "data-[side=inline-start]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=inline-end]:slide-in-from-left-2"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # Supporting text. The controller points the content's aria-describedby at it.
  class PopoverDescription < Base
    def view_template(&)
      p(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        id: "popover-description-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}",
        data: {slot: "popover-description", ruby_ui__popover_target: "description"},
        class: "text-muted-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Groups PopoverTitle and PopoverDescription at the top of the content.
  class PopoverHeader < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "popover-header"},
        class: "flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # The popover's heading. The controller points the content's
  # aria-labelledby at it, so it names the dialog.
  class PopoverTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      h2(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        id: "popover-title-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}",
        data: {slot: "popover-title", ruby_ui__popover_target: "title"},
        class: "font-medium"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Wraps the element that opens the popover (usually a Button). It opens on
  # click, Enter or Space. open_on_hover: also opens it when the pointer rests
  # on the trigger for delay: ms, and closes it close_delay: ms after the
  # pointer leaves both the trigger and the content (shadcn's PopoverTrigger:
  # 300 and 0, plus a short grace to cross the gap onto the content).
  class PopoverTrigger < Base
    def initialize(open_on_hover: nil, delay: nil, close_delay: nil, **attrs)
      @open_on_hover = open_on_hover
      @delay = delay
      @close_delay = close_delay
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "popover-trigger",
          ruby_ui__popover_target: "trigger",
          # Unset (nil) lets Popover's older options trigger: "hover" apply; false turns hover off.
          open_on_hover: @open_on_hover&.to_s,
          delay: @delay,
          close_delay: @close_delay
        },
        class: "inline-block"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Popover

Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
Popover do
  PopoverTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Popover" }
  end
  PopoverContent(align: :start) do
    PopoverHeader do
      PopoverTitle { "Dimensions" }
      PopoverDescription { "Set the dimensions for the layer." }
    end
  end
end
```

### Sides

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-wrap gap-2") do
  [:inline_start, :left, :top, :bottom, :right, :inline_end].each do |side|
    Popover do
      PopoverTrigger do
        Button(variant: :outline, class: "capitalize") { side.to_s.tr("_", " ") }
      end
      PopoverContent(side: side, class: "w-40", aria: {label: "Popover on \#{side.to_s.tr("_", " ")}"}) do
        p { "Popover on \#{side.to_s.tr("_", " ")}" }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Alignments

```ruby
div(class: "flex gap-6") do
  [:start, :center, :end].each do |align|
    Popover do
      PopoverTrigger do
        Button(variant: :outline, size: :sm, class: "capitalize") { align.to_s }
      end
      PopoverContent(align: align, class: "w-40", aria: {label: "Aligned to \#{align}"}) { "Aligned to \#{align}" }
    end
  end
end
```

### With form

```ruby
Popover do
  PopoverTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Popover" }
  end
  PopoverContent(align: :start, class: "w-64") do
    PopoverHeader do
      PopoverTitle { "Dimensions" }
      PopoverDescription { "Set the dimensions for the layer." }
    end
    div(class: "flex flex-col gap-4") do
      div(class: "flex items-center gap-2") do
        FormFieldLabel(for: "popover-width", class: "w-1/2") { "Width" }
        Input(id: "popover-width", value: "100%")
      end
      div(class: "flex items-center gap-2") do
        FormFieldLabel(for: "popover-height", class: "w-1/2") { "Height" }
        Input(id: "popover-height", value: "25px")
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Open on hover

```ruby
Popover do
  PopoverTrigger(open_on_hover: true, delay: 100, close_delay: 100) do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Hover me" }
  end
  PopoverContent do
    PopoverHeader do
      PopoverTitle { "Hover popover" }
      PopoverDescription { "Opens while the pointer rests on the trigger." }
    end
  end
end
```

### In a dialog

```ruby
Dialog do
  DialogTrigger do
    Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Dialog" }
  end
  DialogContent do
    DialogHeader do
      DialogTitle { "Popover Example" }
      DialogDescription { "Click the button below to see the popover." }
    end
    Popover do
      PopoverTrigger do
        Button(variant: :outline, class: "w-fit") { "Open Popover" }
      end
      PopoverContent(align: :start) do
        PopoverHeader do
          PopoverTitle { "Popover in Dialog" }
          PopoverDescription { "This popover appears inside a dialog. Click the button to open it." }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Inside a clipping container

```ruby
div(class: "relative h-24 w-64 overflow-hidden rounded-md border p-4") do
  Popover do
    PopoverTrigger do
      Button(variant: :outline) { "Open Popover" }
    end
    PopoverContent(aria: {label: "Clipping example"}) do
      p { "Not clipped by the container above." }
    end
  end
end
```
